title: (RHEA-2017:0325) Removal of Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Technical Preview
portal_summary:
This errata is for the removal of the Technical Preview of Fuse Integration Services 2.0.

The Tech Preview is now superseded by the GA release of Fuse Integration Services 2.0 as detailed in RHEA-2017:0288-03.

IMPORTANT: Please upgrade your builds to the GA images as soon as possible, the Tech Preview images will be removed on 6th March 2017.
portal_synopsis: Removal of Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Technical Preview
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_jboss_middleware_for_openshift/3/html-single/red_hat_jboss_fuse_integration_services_2.0_for_openshift/
portal_description: Red Hat JBoss Fuse Integration Services provides a set of tools and containerized xPaaS images that enable development, deployment, and management of integration microservices within OpenShift.
